source.title: Ulster Herald, 27 May 1961, p. 11 ("Notice of result of elections: Rural District of Castlederg")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the returning officer's notice of result read in the Ulster Herald of 27 May 1961, p. 11.

note: Triennial election of Castlederg Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was no election in the district; all sixteen members were declared elected without a poll. Declared duly elected; no poll. Returned unopposed.
